legend: After learning a lot about space exploration, a little girl named Ana wants to change the subject.

Ana is a girl who loves palindromes (string that can be read the same backwards as forward). She has learned how to check for a given string whether it's a palindrome or not, but soon she grew tired of this problem, so she came up with a more interesting one and she needs your help to solve it:

You are given an array of strings which consist of only small letters of the alphabet. Your task is to find how many palindrome pairs are there in the array. A palindrome pair is a pair of strings such that the following condition holds: at least one permutation of the concatenation of the two strings is a palindrome. In other words, if you have two strings, let's say "aab" and "abcac", and you concatenate them into "aababcac", we have to check if there exists a permutation of this new string such that it is a palindrome (in this case there exists the permutation "aabccbaa").
Two pairs are considered different if the strings are located on different indices. The pair of strings with indices (i,j)$$$(i,j)$$$ is considered the same as the pair (j,i)$$$(j,i)$$$.
input: The first line contains a positive integer N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤100000$$$1 \le N \le 100\,000$$$), representing the length of the input array.
Eacg of the next N$$$N$$$ lines contains a string (consisting of lowercase English letters from 'a' to 'z') — an element of the input array.
The total number of characters in the input array will be less than 1000000$$$1\,000\,000$$$.
output: Output one number, representing how many palindrome pairs there are in the array.

examples.input:
6
aab
abcac
dffe
ed
aa
aade

legend.ai: 在学到了许多关于太空探索的知识后，一个名叫 Ana 的小女孩想要换个话题。
Ana 是一个喜欢回文的女孩（回文是指正着读和倒着读都相同的字符串）。她已经学会了如何判断给定字符串是否为回文，但她很快就厌倦了这个问题，于是她想出了一个更有趣的问题，需要你的帮助来解决：
给定一个仅由小写字母组成的字符串数组。你的任务是求数组中有多少对回文对。一对回文对是指满足以下条件的一对字符串：两个字符串拼接后，至少存在一种排列方式使其成为回文。换句话说，假设有两个字符串 "aab" 和 "abcac"，将它们拼接成 "aababcac" 后，我们需要判断这个新字符串是否存在一种排列方式使其成为回文（在这个例子中，排列 "aabccbaa" 满足条件）。
如果字符串位于不同的下标，则认为两对字符串不同。下标为 (i,j)$$$(i,j)$$$ 的字符串对与下标为 (j,i)$$$(j,i)$$$ 的字符串对被视为同一对。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个正整数 N$$$N$$$(1≤N≤100000$$$1 \le N \le 100\,000$$$)，表示输入数组的长度。
接下来的 N$$$N$$$ 行中的每一行包含一个字符串(由从 'a' 到 'z' 的小写英文字母组成)——输入数组中的一个元素。
输入数组中所有字符串的字符总数小于 1000000$$$1\,000\,000$$$。

output.ai: 输出一个数字，表示数组中有多少个回文对。
